rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the police force or a police officer.

example.english: The police are maintaining order outside the cordon.
example.traditional: 警察喺封鎖線外面維持秩序。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 hai2 fung1 so2 sin3 ngoi6 min6 wai4 ci4 dit6 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when referring specifically to an individual police officer.

example.english: A police officer stopped a car earlier.
example.traditional: 頭先有個差人截停咗架車。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 jau5 go3 caai1 jan4 zit6 ting4 zo2 gaa3 ce1
